evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said biome-format found no biome binary. Is Biome installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for the biome binary. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /biome-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Resolves biome the way the hook does (node_modules/.bin walk, then PATH) rather than a bare assumption
Does not run `apply`, `npm install`, `npx`, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/biome-format:check

The check failed. Just install biome for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /biome-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not install biome itself and does not invoke `npx`
Names /biome-format:setup apply as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim biome is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When biome resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /biome-format:setup apply
